Verify the executed purge is surgical inside that shared media query, not a line-range delete, and that no @keyframes (scene-shift/scene-sway/scene-steam) are left dangling or accidentally caught by an over-broad removal.

P2: If RoomSpreads/JournalHome drop the aria-label landmark structure Stage.tsx provides today, a screen-reader user loses the ability to jump directly to the porch or a specific room in a page that has grown from one labeled region into a long, undifferentiated flow — a real regression the plan's Truths section never states a test for.
